name: jice-nospam/doryen-rs
description: ASCII roguelike library in Rust with native and WebAssembly support, created by libtcod's original author as a spiritual successor. Features GLSL rendering, Unicode support, and subcell resolution for modern platforms.
score_rationale: 288-star Rust+WASM roguelike library from libtcod's creator, useful as a reference though less active than bracket-lib.
summary: Rust+WASM roguelike library from libtcod's creator with GLSL rendering
